known_gaps: The page summarizes the current product and memory model from canonical docs and current ADRs, but it does not inspect all implementation files behind the roadmap evidence paths.
Practice Memory and Personal Memory are documented as target layers because the current roadmap defers their full implementation until after Project Memory quality is proven.
The active Step 6.5 vision-quality gate is not yet implemented in the target snapshot, so the page describes it as current planned work rather than completed behavior.
